body: U24 assigned and pushed at f4c5fc7: the SCORECARD SCREEN. ScorecardRead.build() already returns per-judge rounds, totals, winner_side and disagreement_rounds - nothing renders any of it. R85R calls it 'the one screen R84 has all the numbers for and renders none of', and it is a rendering job, not a modelling one. It was blocked and is not any more: R84's 'split decisions are impossible' was true only of the DEFAULT scoring profile; under boxing's own ruleset 7 of 14 panels hand in different totals. Read research/TASK_U24.md and nothing else.
